title: Client suite never exercises the correction_cycles >= 1 effective-contact arms — the r1 W4 'corrected-only, never snapshot fallback' rule is unpinned
detail: Every client fixture pins correction_cycles: 0, and edit_trio_prefills_effective_contact_test (line 1448) is dict-seeded — the rendered values come from the seeded RefcheckEdit, so the prefill/chips fallback is never computed. The load-bearing post-correction arms (True -> corrected only: a cleared channel stays absent, AD-7 never-re-contact) would regress to snapshot-fallback without any client test failing.
recommended_fix: Add a panel test with correction_cycles: 1 + corrected_phone: None asserting the phone chip is absent (never the snapshot), and a handler test that UserChoseRefcheckAction(RefcheckCorrect) prefills corrected values.

title: The r4 N13 Objected-row overflow-menu arm (Objected -> Substitute) is unpinned at the view level
detail: All three menu_open tests in reference_panel_test.gleam use Queued (1183, 1201) or Skipped (1225) rows; the Objected tests (1493, 1542, 1585) render the body substitute surface with the menu closed. Deleting the Objected arm from overflow_actions would pass the whole client suite — only the body affordance (which also gates on the hook) remains.
recommended_fix: Add a render test opening the menu on an Objected row with can_substitute_referee: True and assert refcheck-action-substitute-landlord_ref appears (and absent when the hook is off).
